public_rationale: Marcus predicted that ChatGPT would be used to build more networks of fake websites made to sell ads. In May 2023, NewsGuard reported finding 49 news-style sites, mostly or entirely written by AI, that churn out clickbait to earn ad revenue. One of them published an OpenAI refusal message, which ties at least some of these sites to OpenAI's models. NewsGuard's tracker later counted 3,749 such sites by June 2026 and said they are often funded by programmatic advertising. This settles the open-ended forecast early, under the stated rule.
limitations: Most sites are attributed to AI chatbots in general, not to ChatGPT specifically.
NewsGuard's counts depend on its own criteria and search methods.

our_interpretation: Read as: after the post, ChatGPT or similar chatbots would be used to produce growing numbers of fake or low-quality websites, often in networks, that exist to earn advertising revenue.

No deadline was stated, so the claim is treated as open-ended. It can be settled early by credible documentation of such sites appearing and growing in number.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Investigators look for such sites and find no meaningful growth in AI-generated ad-driven sites.
